name: Toufuya
title: Dokkai Dojo
lead: JLPT reading drills N5-N1 set at a fictional neighborhood tofu shop: a regular-closing-day notice, a first day helping at the shop, a product price guide, a tofu-making workshop notice, a new-apprentice training plan comparison, a story about noticing a regular customer's change through good service, a trainee lesson on tofu-making basics, an explainer on why an old stone mill is still kept, a home-delivery service application guide, a column on how more supermarket tofu changed the shop's work, a year-end-season order rule, a column on the meaning of a craftsman's skill in judging the coagulant, and a one-year neighborhood tofu-shop-association cooperation report. Original texts, answers with the reason for every choice.
